name: smwblocks-16x16-pipe
title: 16x16 Pipe
description:
This is a 16x16 pipe that can only be entered from above.
What's special about this is you can't enter the pipe "from the edge of the block" and only if you are centered on it enough.
ASMers can probably figure out how to make the enter from below version.
Crafty people should already be able to do this sideways with vanilla resources.
